name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 5 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2026-06-01, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
